smartrecruiters:BoschGroup:7440001541730.title: Automotive Systems Diagnostic and troubleshooting Engineer
smartrecruiters:BoschGroup:7440001541730.text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Job Desc    Should be able to diagnose vehicle independently, troubleshooting and repairing electrical systems in vehicles, create content for Guided trouble shooting.Must Have Skills•    Research and create high-quality, informative, and engaging automotive content using different Authoring tools.•    Strong knowledge of Gasoline, Diesel, Comfort & Safety systems. With detail workflow & working of sensors & actuators involved in these systems.•    Familiarity with tools, equipment, and procedures related to removal & refit is important. This knowledge will allow to create informative and instructional content. •    Diagnose electronic, mechanical, and electrical systems problems in Vehicle using different testers & Diagnoses tools.•    Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) identification and understanding the specific error code that has been generated.•    Conduct vehicle testing, including Individual component testing. Proficiency in using automotive testing and diagnostic equipment, such as OBD-II scanners, multimeters, and oscilloscopes.•    Understanding of automotive electrical system wiring diagram, wire color codes, connectors, and components and its functionalities. Including understanding symbols & DIN standards•    Maintain detailed document records of system tests, Removal & refit procedures, and results for reference and guidelines.Good to have Skillso    Use of OE testers & OE descriptionso    OBD – II standardso    Guided troubleshooting  SKILL PRIORITYSKILL-1    Vehicle diagnosticSKILL-2    Guided trouble shooting of fault codes SKILL-3    OBD- II standards SKILL-4    DIN standards in wiring diagramSKILL-5    HV & EV Knowledge CERTIFICATION REQUIRED•    Relevant certification in Automotive Mechatronics is an added advantage.•    Hybrid and Electric Vehicle Systems (Level 2 and Level 3) certification.
Qualifications
BE/ B. Tech/ ME/ M. Tech- Automobile/Mechanical
Additional Information
3-6

Should be able to perform as an Individual developer for the project team in Automotive diagnostic Content generation for Bosch IAM tool chain Automotive diagnostic Knowledge knowledge in Vehicle communication network (CAN/SAE/Flexray/LIN/KWP/MOST/UDS/CANFD/DOIP) Vehicle diagnostic content authoring & Validation Vehicle testing & diagnostics of various ECUADAS application sequence creation & calibration Experience in handling OEM/IAM Vehicle Diagnostic tools Experience in Vehicle diagnostic content authoring & Validation Experience in reverse engineering process and its implementation/validation using vehicle simulator Strong knowledge in Vehicle communication network (CAN/SAE/Flexray/LIN/KWP/MOST/UDS) and related protocols Experience in Vehicle testing & diagnostics of various ECU(Electronic Control Unit) systems Thorough knowledge of diagnostic assets (Identification, DTC, Sensor data, Actuators and Special Tests)Experience in Vector tools and Samtec tools such as CANdela, CANoe, CANdiva , ODX Studio, HSX and  HS+., ODX data and AUTOSAR is preferable Vehicle knowledge with ADAS controllers with calibration/Reset functions Experience in ADAS application sequence creation & calibration of the same Able to extract service manuals from OEM portals and able to do Reverse Engineer with OEM tools Exposure to any of the programming language (Python, C#, SQL etc.) would be added advantage.Excellent problem identification and solving skills (exposure to CAR, 8D, etc)Certification   On-Board Diagnostics (OBD-II) Certification SAE J2534 Programming & Diagnostics Certification Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) CertificationsCertifications related to DOIP

3-6 yrs

C# and Database Engineer : Location: Coimbatore  Primary Responsibilities:Role Overview:3 to 6 years experienceWe are looking for a C# Specialist with deep expertise in automation and diagnostics within the automotive domain. The ideal candidate will lead the design, development, and enhancement of automation frameworks and diagnostic tools, with additional skills in Python scripting and database integration. Key Responsibilities:Design and develop robust, scalable automation frameworks and diagnostic tools using C# as the primary language.Integrate database systems (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.) for test data management, logging, and reporting.Utilize Python for auxiliary scripting, data processing, and tool support.Work on on-board and off-board diagnosticsCollaborate with global teams to develop and validate remote diagnostics and remote update capabilities.Analyze complex system requirements and propose innovative automation solutions.Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in software development and diagnostics. Required Skills & Experience:Expert-level proficiency in C# for automation, diagnostics, and tool development.Solid experience in automotive diagnostics, including CAN, UDS, Ethernet, and DoIP protocols.Hands-on experience with database design, SQL queries, and data-driven testing.Working knowledge of Python for scripting and data analysis.Experience with ECU testing, functional diagnostics, and control unit communication.
